draft_64k_nvfp4_head.source: 65536-row slice of the NVFP4 head: 65536*2560 packed U8 + 65536*320 F8_E4M3 block scales (row-aligned by construction)

fp8_head.source: plan-B: lm_head dequantised to FP8 per-channel (weight F8_E4M3 [248320,5120] + weight_scale BF16 [248320,1]); corroborated by the unsloth lm_head surgery byte delta

full_bf16_head.source: the unsloth arm's served head, kept as the comparison baseline

mtp_forward.source: summed tensor spans of mtp.* (15 tensors, all BF16)

mtp_forward_fp8_requant.source: PROJECTION: 2-D mtp matrices at FP8 e4m3 + 128x128 F32 block scales, 1-D norms left BF16

nvfp4_head.source: summed tensor spans of lm_head.* as shipped (ModelOpt NVFP4 4-tensor set)

target_model.source: summed tensor spans of model.language_model.* minus embed_tokens (64 decoder layers + final norm)

derivation: every byte term is a SUM of real safetensors tensor spans in /models/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-radixark (2194 tensors, 21,921,428,072 B total, == the repo's own qualification.json output_indexed_payload_bytes); no FR13 or FR14 constant was scaled and the staged design-note estimate was not trusted

excluded_from_floor.why: neither is read on a decode step

root_64k_bf16_head_bf16_draft.note: WORST CASE -- the unsloth arm's head treatment applied to the aggressive backbone; shows how little the backbone alone buys.

root_64k_fp8_head_bf16_draft.note: PLAN B -- if NVFP4 lm_head cannot serve, dequant the head to FP8 per-channel (NOT BF16).

root_64k_nvfp4_head_bf16_draft.note: PHASE 1 -- what this arm can serve the moment the lm_head patch boots: DVK dequants the sliced rows to BF16, leaving the sealed BF16 GEMV units and the 128-block map untouched.

root_64k_nvfp4_head_nvfp4_draft.note: PHASE 2 -- needs an FP4 draft-head GEMV unit; its own byte gate.

root_64k_nvfp4_head_nvfp4_draft_mtp_fp8.note: PHASE 2 + the MTP-FP8 local-requant lever stacked on top.
